summary: The agent implements a basic LightGBM solution with a valid train/validation split and early stopping, but misses critical preprocessing steps. It fails to explicitly handle missing values (relying entirely on the model) and performs zero feature engineering. Furthermore, its simplistic check for categorical columns causes natively numeric categoricals to be treated as continuous variables, depriving the model of explicit categorical splits.
